note: JRA directly maps provisional/unofficial result to a temporary placing before confirmation.
JRA directly maps runner-up to the second-placed horse.
JRA terminology plus a current IHRB stewards report support Objection while preserving jurisdiction-specific procedure.
Official Australian stewards reporting supports Protest as a rider-lodged placing/interference challenge.
Equibase official charting supports Claim of foul as a North American interference complaint before the result stands or changes.
Current HKJC result guidance identifies VOID as an invalid/void race state; scope narrowed to Hong Kong/Regional.
Current ARCI/USTA material supports No contest as a North American race status with no winner; settlement rules remain local.
Seed code DNF is normalized to the semantic Concept Did not finish; DNF moved to the abbreviation layer.
Seed code PU is normalized to Pulled up; P/PU moved to the abbreviation layer.
Seed code F is normalized to Fell; F moved to the abbreviation layer.
Seed code UR is normalized to Unseated rider; U/UR moved to the abbreviation layer.
Seed code BD is normalized to Brought down; BD moved to the abbreviation layer.
Seed label REF is replaced by semantic Concept Refused because current Jockey Club form guidance uses R; R moved to the abbreviation layer.
DQ is a current USTA abbreviation for Disqualified and is retired into RESULT-014 Disqualification.
DH is a current USTA abbreviation for Dead Heat and is retired into RESULT-007 Dead heat.
